items.title: Sheila Cameron to step down as CEO of Lloyd’s Market Association
items.summary: Sheila Cameron is leaving her role representing managing agents at the LMA in the new year after leading the organisation since 2019.

items.title: Commercial e-trading software requires greater broker challenge, say tech leaders
items.summary: SSP UK and Ireland and IS2 executives argue that commercial lines brokers must push technology providers harder on product access, referrals and self-service capabilities.

items.title: BTPS funding improves with deficit falling by £1bn
items.summary: The BT Pension Scheme has agreed its 2026 triennial valuation with BT Group, showing a reduced deficit and outlining additional funding requirements.

items.title: HDI Global UK & Ireland names head of political violence and terrorism
items.summary: Ashwin Kapoor takes over leadership of the political violence and terrorism division alongside underwriting manager Tom Brown, with both joining from Aviva on 1 December 2026.

items.title: FCA restricts debt collector over disguised remuneration loan demands
items.summary: Ethica Resolve Limited has agreed to FCA restrictions regarding repayment demands for disguised remuneration scheme loans sold by West 28th Street Limited.

items.title: LCP highlights workplace pensions as key employer priority
items.summary: A new report from consultancy LCP examines key considerations and opportunities for UK pension schemes as workplace pensions undergo a period of change.
